CAN.note: World's #1 potash (MOP, HS 3104) producer/exporter; Saskatchewan basin. Production per IFA/USGS 2024. Small N/P imports from US.

RUS.note: Top-3 in all three nutrients: potash (3104), nitrogen/urea (3102), phosphate/NPK (3105). Western sanctions since 2022 reroute volumes to India/Brazil/China but fertilizer largely exempt; flows confirmed via importer WITS reports.

BLR.note: Belaruskali — major MOP/potash (3104) exporter. EU/US sanctions since 2021 cut Western markets; redirected to China (2,888 kt observed) and Brazil. K2O-equivalent, IFA/USDA 2024 estimate.

CHN.note: Largest producer & consumer of N (urea, 3102) and P (3105); large net potash (3104) importer (~12.9 Mt gross, WITS). Periodic urea export curbs to protect domestic supply.

MAR.note: OCP — world's #1 phosphate/DAP-MAP (3105) exporter from Khouribga reserves. Product tonnage, IFA/USDA 2024.

USA.note: Large net importer: potash (3104) ~14.2 Mt mostly from Canada (12.1 Mt observed, WITS); nitrogen (3102) ~9.4 Mt. Major phosphate producer (Mosaic, Florida). Import figures from WITS 2024.

IND.note: World's biggest fertilizer importer by dependency: 100% of potash (3104, 4.4 Mt), most phosphate/NPK (3105, 6.9 Mt) and large urea (3102, 7.7 Mt) imported. Gross product imports summed from WITS 2024.

BRA.note: Largest single-country fertilizer importer by tonnage (~41 Mt gross): potash (3104) 16.0 Mt, nitrogen (3102) 16.4 Mt, phosphate/NPK (3105) 8.7 Mt. Sums of WITS 2024 gross imports; ~85% import-dependent.

QAT.note: Major urea/nitrogen (3102) exporter (QAFCO) on cheap gas. Exports confirmed via India/Brazil/US importer WITS reports.

EGY.note: Nitrogen/urea (3102) exporter on domestic gas; production occasionally curtailed by gas shortages. IFA/USDA 2024 estimate; not second-sourced via Comtrade.

SAU.note: Ma'aden — large nitrogen/urea (3102) and phosphate/DAP (3105) exporter. Phosphate exports to India (2,152 kt) and Brazil confirmed via WITS. Product tonnage, IFA 2024.

OMN.note: Urea/nitrogen (3102) exporter (OQ/Sohar). Largest single nitrogen supplier to India (2,576 kt observed, WITS).

NGA.note: Emerging urea/nitrogen (3102) exporter (Dangote, Indorama) on Niger Delta gas. Supplied 1,586 kt N to Brazil (WITS-observed).

IDN.note: Large urea/nitrogen (3102) producer (Pupuk Indonesia); modest net exporter of N, importer of potash (3104, all imported) and phosphate. IFA/USDA 2024 estimate; not Comtrade-verified.

AUS.note: Net importer of all nutrients; small domestic N production. Imports urea, MOP (3104) and DAP/NPK (3105). IFA/USDA 2024 estimate; importer detail not pulled from WITS.

BGD.note: Net importer; imports urea (3102), MOP (3104) and DAP (3105) for rice/wheat. IFA/FAO 2024 estimate; importer-side WITS not pulled.

VNM.note: Roughly balanced; produces urea/nitrogen (3102), imports potash (3104, fully imported) and some phosphate. IFA/USDA 2024 estimate; not Comtrade-verified.

TUR.note: Net importer of urea (3102), potash (3104) and NPK (3105). IFA/USDA 2024 estimate; importer-side WITS not pulled.

ARG.note: Net importer for soy/maize/wheat belt; imports urea (3102), MAP (3105) and MOP (3104). IFA/USDA 2024 estimate; not Comtrade-verified.

rankings.note: Exporter ranks are IFA/USDA 2024 product-tonnage estimates across all three nutrient types (Russia leads on combined N+P+K). Importer ranks: Brazil/India/USA/China gross product imports summed from WITS 2024 importer reports; smaller importers (AUS, TUR, ARG, IDN, BGD, VNM) are IFA/USDA estimates, not Comtrade-verified. Flows merge nutrient types per country pair (one map line per pair); each note itemizes the N/P/K split.

companies.name: Nutrien
companies.metric: Revenue ~US$26.0bn (FY2024); world's largest fertilizer company by capacity
companies.note: Top potash (MOP) producer plus N and P, and a large ag-retail arm.
companies.improve: Should publish potash export tonnage by destination to show its weight in the Canada-to-US/Brazil/India lanes.

companies.name: Yara International
companies.note: Leading global nitrogen/urea (HS 3102) producer and ammonia trader, with European gas-price exposure.
companies.improve: Should disclose gas-cost-driven plant utilization and the regional split of its urea output for supply-security analysis.

companies.name: Mosaic
companies.note: Major North American phosphate (DAP/MAP) and potash producer; supplies MAP to Brazil.
companies.improve: Should report phosphate-rock reserve life and the Florida-vs-import feedstock split given US phosphate concentration.

companies.name: OCP Group
companies.note: Morocco's state phosphate champion, controlling the bulk of world phosphate-rock reserves.
companies.improve: Should disclose per-destination DAP/MAP tonnage and cadmium-content compliance for EU market access.

companies.name: EuroChem
companies.note: Russia-rooted integrated N, P and potash producer (Swiss-domiciled). Sanctions-sensitive; flows largely continue to India/Brazil.
companies.improve: As a sanctions-exposed private firm, should clarify ownership/control and the share of output routed through non-sanctioned channels.

companies.name: PhosAgro
companies.note: Russia's leading phosphate/NPK (HS 3105) producer; key supplier to Brazil and India.
companies.improve: Should disclose export-destination tonnage given the geopolitical concentration risk it represents for Brazil/India food systems.

global.note: Global fertilizer measured in kt of nutrients (N + P2O5 + K2O), IFA medium-term outlook basis. 2022 dip reflects the energy/price shock and Russia/Belarus disruption after the Ukraine invasion; recovery through 2023-2024. NOTE: the global series is nutrient-tonnes while flows are product-tonnes — different bases.
